summary: Frontend-only verification of new ProjectSidebar on /work/:slug. All acceptance criteria pass: 6 round icons render with correct data-testids, burger-hot active by default. On hover, sidebar width transitions 72 -> 300px; thumbs morph to 260x150 rectangles; labels reach opacity 1. .sidebar-track has overflow-y auto. Clicking sidebar-item-yaloo navigates to /work/yaloo, hero title becomes 'Yaloo', and yaloo item gains .active class. About-the-project button toggles drawer open/close and shows drawer title. Prev/Next navigation works. On 390px viewport the sidebar is display:none. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Tags count observed = 2 for Yaloo (mock has 2 tags: BRANDING, DIGITAL PRESENCE) — matches data; no issue.
ProjectSidebar useEffect dependency only [] but adds listeners once; updateBlob is recalled via useLayoutEffect on activeSlug/expanded — OK.
Consider adding data-testid on drawer for future assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Case-study left sidebar verified end-to-end (hover expand, blob-active class, click-to-navigate, mobile hidden, about drawer). Base URL from frontend/.env.
